description: This file provides internal implementation of submodule configuration management within a Git repository. It includes structures and functions for parsing, caching, looking up, and managing submodule configurations based on .gitmodules files, with support for different lookup types, reference handling, and configuration updates.

classes.name: submodule_cache
classes.description: Structure for caching submodule configurations, avoiding redundant reads and lookups.

classes.name: submodule_entry
classes.description: Wrapper for submodule configuration entries used in hashmaps.

classes.name: fetch_config
classes.description: Structure to hold fetch-related configuration parameters for gitmodules.
